title.narrative: Fiscal Management and Public Sector Performance Technical Assistance Loan

description.narrative: The objective of the Fiscal Management and Public Sector Performance Technical Assistance Loan Project for El Salvador is to strengthen the institutional capacity of specific government processes and agencies to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of revenue and expenditure management, and enhance accountability and transparency in the public sector. There are four components to the project. The first component of the project is strengthening tax collection agencies. This component will provide support to the Ministry of Finance (MoF) to implement a short-term tax collection package and strengthen the MoF's institutional capacities in tax administration. The second component of the project is modernizing of public expenditures and financial management. This component will help the MoF to review and further modernize existing budget and financial management systems, including the public procurement system. The third component of the project is enhancing and piloting information management and public sector transparency initiatives. This component will support government efforts to modernize its institutional framework for Public Financial Management (PFM), and to develop policies and instruments to improve statistics and information management and transparency. The fourth component of the project is project coordination and strengthening of the MoF. This component will provide support to the MoF to adequately coordinate and monitor project implementation.

To strengthen the institutional capacity of specific government processes and agencies to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of revenue and expenditure management and enhance accountability and transparency in the public sector.
